changelog: 0.0.1 - feat: phase 1 - error boundaries and legacy v1 component excision
0.0.1 - refactor: library sync optimizations, UI/UX polish, and offline improvements
0.0.1 - fix: correctly identify synthetic queue IDs starting with flow- and route them to FlowItemView instead of attempting to fetch a missing PDF
0.0.1 - fix: make fetchFileById resilient to UUID database string corruption where hyphens are replaced by underscores
0.0.1 - fix: extract inline Wrapper component in PerformPage to prevent continuous React unmount/remount destruction loops on PDFViewer
0.0.1 - fix: exclude PWA manifest and service worker files from middleware auth redirects to fix JSON syntax error
0.0.1 - fix: rename rxdb instance to sheet-music-db-v2 to permanently bypass all corrupted version 0 IndexedDB schema caches across all clients
0.0.1 - fix: implement global rxdb try-catch to destroy and wipe corrupted IndexedDB instances if the old stored schema is invalid during migration
0.0.1 - fix: import RxDBMigrationsSchemaPlugin required for version migrations
0.0.1 - fix: bump rxdb schema version to 1 and add cache-dropping migration strategy to fix DB6 mismatch
0.0.1 - fix: resolve RxDB DXE1 strict schema error and PWA service-worker range request no-response crashes
0.0.1 - fix: relax Next.js 15 route handler parameter typings in custom api-wrapper
